environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB in us-west-2. The ALB has three AWS WAF WebACL rule groups attached in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, and (3) a custom rule group with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|(?:\'|\%27)\s*(?:or|and)\s+)` with BLOCK action. The ALB target group health check path is /api/health. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for S3 (gateway) and CloudWatch Logs (interface endpoint), preventing DNS-based or HTTP-based data exfiltration channels from out-of-band SQLi techniques.

config.waf_rule_1: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet (SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING overridden to COUNT, all others BLOCK)
config.network_egress: ECS task security group egress limited to VPC endpoints only (S3 gateway, CloudWatch Logs interface endpoint). No internet egress, no NAT gateway.
